text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I drop in on Symboli Rudolf to arrange
our next
training session, but she seems
a little under the
weather.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Just a headache, nothing more. All it
needs is
time.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
More to the point, there is a mountain of
work to
do before the end of the day.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I have reference documents to compile
for this
week's budget meeting,
requisition forms to
approve, and more
besides...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I would like to get it all out of the way
as quickly
as possible, but... Ngh.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
If it weren't for this headache, I would
be done by
now. Nothing can ever be
simple, it seems...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It sounds like Symboli Rudolf's headache
is
causing her more trouble than she's
willing to
admit.
